meta.name: Adv. Achinta Aich
meta.description: Following a shocking high-profile murder with several eyewitnesses, the only suspect in the seemingly open-and-shut case turns to Achinta Aich, a notary lawyer with few resources. As Achinta risks his all in a quest for justice, he uncovers a web of secrets and sins that hold the key to the truth.

videos.title: Pablo Hotyakando
videos.overview: Sarod player Pablo Dutta's wife Malini is the prime suspect in his murder. Things become worse when the Dutta family enlists a formidable criminal lawyer to prove Malini guilty.

videos.title: Mukhbondho
videos.overview: The ruthless prison environment leads Malini to make a drastic move. Amidst the old bitterness with Sitaram, Malini's desperation drives Achinta to take up the case.

videos.title: Asst Lakkhan Bhim Sardar
videos.overview: When Sitaram is determined to ensure the harshest punishment for Malini, Achinta discovers some facts about Pablo that can turn the case around.

videos.title: Ami Pablo-ke Marini
videos.overview: Achinta begins to keep tabs on Srijita's whereabouts. On the first day of the trial, Sitaram tries to quell Achinta by hitting a raw nerve.

videos.title: 15 Jon Shakkhi
videos.overview: Sitaram tries to intimidate Achinta, but not enough to stop him from gathering vital evidence. Things take a new turn when the main eyewitness recants her statement.

videos.title: Damini Case
videos.overview: Achinta delves into the dark underbelly of the Dutta family's history. A furious Debnath pressurises Sitaram to stop Achinta at any cost.

videos.title: Dutta Barir Itihash
videos.overview: Pablo's murder mystery takes a new turn when a two-decade-old unsolved murder case suddenly comes to light.

videos.title: Nyay Onnyay
videos.overview: Ranajoy is accused of killing Dyuti, but his daughter Nupur believes he's innocent as Achinta searches for the truth.

videos.title: Bhutum
videos.overview: POCSO expert Nandini Ganguly takes on Dyuti's case. Achinta panics, as he has never handled such a trial before.

videos.title: POCSO
videos.overview: Rajveer claims Ranajoy was the last to leave before Dyuti's death. Will Achinta find a witness to turn the case around?

videos.title: Shomon
videos.overview: Society turns on Achinta. Nupur is threatened, goons attack them. Did Achinta make a mistake defending Ranajoy?

videos.title: Bichar
videos.overview: Nandini corners Achinta in court, Ranajoy is attacked in jail. Now, Achinta's next move could change everything.

videos.title: Investigation
videos.overview: Achinta finds a shocking clue at Dyuti's house, while Bhim and Geeta uncover a game-changing twist.

videos.title: Nyay Dokhol
videos.overview: As Achinta presents a key witness, a truth about Dyuti stuns everyone as lies unravel. Can he win the case for Nupur?

videos.title: Bawal Shonyashi
videos.overview: A man presumed dead returns during his own funeral. Achinta steps in to uncover whether he's Neel - or an imposter.

videos.title: Biye Maneyi Consent
videos.overview: As Achinta digs deeper, buried secrets emerge. But someone is determined to silence the truth forever.

videos.title: Court'e Dekha Hobey
videos.overview: As Achinta digs deeper, buried secrets emerge. But someone is determined to silence the truth forever.

videos.title: Memory Game
videos.overview: Every testimony raises fresh doubts. As the evidence shifts, the mystery surrounding Neel deepens further.

videos.title: Secret Witness
videos.overview: A shocking witness changes the course of the trial, putting Debjani at the centre of an explosive revelation.

videos.title: Project Poncho Pandav
videos.overview: Hidden evidence brings Achinta closer to the truth, but every revelation uncovers an even darker conspiracy.

videos.title: Right to Justice
videos.overview: As the final truth unfolds, one last twist changes everything. But who has been playing the longest game?
